# Limine boot protocol header

`limine.h` and `LICENSE` are vendored verbatim from:
https://github.com/limine-bootloader/limine-protocol
Commit: `3a0526b700e356f0eac1b71a77697b3fd1c707a3`
License: 0BSD (retained alongside the header).

This is an interface definition, not a third-party operating-system kernel.
The bootloader release used to build ISO images is separately pinned in Makefile.
